name: Chieng Mai duck
summary: Duck from xã Chiềng Mai, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnam.vn, on 2 April 2024, prints a bird of about 1.5–1.7 kg, small bones, yellow skin, fragrant sweet meat, soft but not falling apart, mostly semi-free range. The preparations it names are boiled, steamed, charcoal-grilled, braised with sấu, and cooked with bamboo, plus sticky rice, duck porridge, lemongrass-chili stir-fry, and galangal stir-fry.
origin: Xã Chiềng Mai, huyện Mai Sơn. Vietnam.vn, 2 April 2024.
taste: Vietnam.vn calls the meat fragrant and sweet, soft but not falling apart.
howToEat: In one of the preparations Vietnam.vn names. An hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Xã Chiềng Mai, huyện Mai Sơn. A shop in the city was not named.
